comparison.objective: Connect and lock a hose quick-connect fitting; unlike separating media from finished parts.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual collar retraction, coaxial insertion, and latch engagement against hose compliance versus pouring and clearing orientation-dependent screen bridges.
comparison.success_condition: Requires seated pawl engagement, collar return, stable release, and pull retention; candidate instead grades recovered media mass, washer retention, spill avoidance, screen support, and release dwell. No material rubric detail is missing.
comparison.reason: It tests compliant connector mating and latching, not bulk separation.
